items.title: Claude Code 2.1.332 released
items.text: Added skills from MCP servers (beta). They show as server:skill in the / menu; other skills keep their names · Added a PreSkillShellCommand hook event that can refuse a skill or command's inline shell commands as it loads; on 2.1.331 and older, a settings file naming it opens a dialog at start · Added "Always deliver" to the prompt for held messages from other sessions · Added a footer line that stays while a flagged message has your session on a different model, until you pick one with /model
